description: The targets every Concord member repo gets from the hub-owned concord.mk. concord.mk is propagated verbatim (propagate/concord.mk) and reads the mod id from gradle.properties, so it is byte-identical in every member; a member's own Makefile includes it and adds only member-specific targets. This file is the machine-readable list of the targets concord.mk owns, enforced by scripts/check-makefile-targets.py (see `make makefile-check`): a member must `include concord.mk`, carry an unmodified copy, and must not redefine any of these targets. The recipes live in concord.mk, not here. Deliberate per-repo additions beyond this set are notes, never drift — the contract is a floor, not a ceiling. Prose rules live in REPO-LAYOUT.md; edit both together.
